programmes.d: James Braxton and Jonathan Pratt discover its worth rifling in basements for bargains.
The competition between Philip Serrell and Catherine Southon intensifies as they journey from Sedburgh to Leeds.

In a Ford Zephyr, auctioneers Charlie Ross and James Braxton continue their hunt from the Lincolnshire town of Stamford, then travel east around Norfolk before ending up at an auction in the Cambridgeshire market town of St Ives.
James Braxton and Jonathan Pratt are determined to up their games.
Philip Serrell and Catherine Southon head from Skipton to Liverpool for their final auction showdown.

Auctioneers Charlie Ross and James Braxton are half-way through their trip in their Ford Zephyr. This leg sets off from Shenton in Leicestershire and takes them to auction in the village of Bourne End, Buckinghamshire.
James Braxton and Jonathan Pratt scour antiques shops between Wells and Crewkerne.
It's day one for expert Thomas Plant and Road Trip newbie, Scottish auctioneer Paul Laidlaw, as they travel from Skipton to Sheffield.

James Braxton is in the lead as they kick off in their Ford Zephyr from Rushden, Northamptonshire, which means Charlie Ross is playing catch up as they search for perfect purchases in Cambridgeshire, Bedfordshire and Buckinghamshire.
James Braxton and Jonathan Pratt head to Cornwall for their final auction showdown.
Day two for dynamic duo Thomas Plant and Paul Laidlaw sees them attempt to outwit each other on their way from Bolsover to the auction in Stamford.

Charlie Ross and James Braxton kick things off in Brasted, then journey through the Kent and Surrey countryside. Charlie takes a risky punt on a pricey purchase, but has he done enough to take the road trip crown from rival James?
David Barby and David Harper travel all the way from Moy to Omagh in Northern Ireland.
It's charm versus mathematical prowess, as experts Thomas Plant and Paul Laidlaw hit the shops between Huntingdon and Towcester.
David Barby and David Harper grapple with Euros as from Athlone to Kells in Ireland.

Antique experts Christina Trevanion and Paul Laidlaw kick off a new season in Suffolk and Cambridgeshire. Armed with £200 each, and an ailing pickup truck, they shop up a storm before heading to an auction in Market Harborough.
Thomas Plant and Paul Laidlaw's negotiating tactics are tested to the limit as they travel from Olney to the auction in Watlington.
David Barby and David Harper have crossed the North Sea to Wales.
Antiques hunters Christina Trevanion and Paul Laidlaw shop across Gloucestershire and Northamptonshire before going head-to-head at an auction in Evesham, Worcestershire.
Thomas Plant and Paul Laidlaw spend their final day of antique adventuring heading from Tetsworth to the final auction showdown in Pewsey.
David Barby’s after something quirky, while David Harper’s going for the killer deal.

Travelling through Hertfordshire, Buckinghamshire, and the West Midlands, Paul Laidlaw uncovers a hidden gem that could win him the trip. All is revealed when he and Christina Trevanion auction their lots in Nantwich, Cheshire.
It's Charlie Ross and Charles Hanson's first day together as they kick off their journey in Bridlington and head to an auction showdown in Doncaster.
David Barby and David Harper’s epic tour ends in Llanelli--but who will be crowned king?
Charlie Ross and Charles Hanson are getting on famously as they drive the second leg of their road trip from Scunthorpe to Grantham.

Christina Trevanion and Paul Laidlaw travel through Shropshire and Worcestershire. Paul gets security clearance to visit Iron Mountain and Christina learns about the origins of the modern Olympic movement in Much Wenlock.
Newcomer Margie Cooper battles it out with veteran Mark Stacey, starting in Chilham, Kent.
The competition heats up on day three as the two Charlies journey from King's Lynn to the auction in Beccles.

Paul Laidlaw and Christina Trevanion are taking in the delights of Staffordshire and Cheshire. Paul has had amazing success on this trip; can Christina catch up as they head towards their final auction in Northwich?
It couldn’t be closer as Margie Cooper and Mark Stacey go hunting from Kent to Essex.
It's day four of Charlie Ross and Charles Hanson's road trip, heading from Lavenham in Suffolk to Greenwich--until their car breaks down.
Antiques experts David Harper and Anita Manning go head-to-head as they road trip through North England and into southern and central Scotland, heading to an auction in Knutsford, Cheshire.
Margie Cooper and Mark Stacey travel from Sawbridgeworth to Chippenham.
The fifth leg of the journey for Charles Hanson and Charlie Ross takes them from Royal Tunbridge Wells to Rye in East Sussex for a final showdown.

David Harper and Anita Manning travel through Yorkshire. Along the way, David learns about a 500-year-old mystery and Anita meets two inspirational Land Girls before they head towards the auction in Harrogate.
Margie Cooper and Mark Stacey end the day at an auction showdown in Sherborne.
It's a new chapter as we hit the road with seasoned auctioneers James Braxton and Jonathan Pratt as they travel from Altrincham to Nantwich.
It’s all down to the last lot as Margie Cooper and Mark Stacey battle it out at auction.
After a successful last auction, David Harper has the lead, but Anita Manning is hot on his heels as they shop in Yorkshire and County Durham before heading into Newcastle for the auction.
James Braxton and Jonathan Pratt search for bargains while traveling from Leek in Staffordshire to Birmingham.
Old hand Thomas Plant and newbie Mark Hales take to the road, from Portrush to Belfast.

It's the penultimate leg for antiques hunters Anita Manning and David Harper. Starting in Northumberland, England, and crossing the border into Scotland, they search for hidden gems before heading to auction in Kinbuck, Stirlingshire.
James Braxton and Jonathan Pratt are determined to up their game as they head from Stratford upon Avon to the auction in Frome, Somerset.
Thomas Plant and Mark Hales travel from Dublin to Portlaoise, in the Republic of Ireland.
It's day four of James Braxton and Jonathan Pratt's road trip as they scour local antique shops between Wells and the auction in Crewkerne.

David Harper and Anita Manning travel to the Isle of Bute, Glasgow and Renfewshire. They both take a massive risk in a bid to win the week, but who will come out on top when they head to the auction in Paisley?
Thomas Plant and Mark Hales battle for the biggest profit in North Wales.
James Braxton and Jonathan Pratt's fifth leg takes them from Crewkerne in Somerset to Lostwithiel in Cornwall for their final auction showdown.

A new pair of auctioneers, Philip Serrell and Natasha Raskin, take to the open road in search for treasure. On their first day, they travel through Wales and end at an auction in Llanelli, Carmarthenshire.
Thomas Plant and Mark Hales end up at a showdown in Carmarthenshire.
It's a brand-new week, hitting the road with David Barby and David Harper as they travel all the way from Moy to Omagh in Northern Ireland.
Antiques hunters Philip Serrell and Natasha Raskin take in the delights of South West Wales before crossing into England and heading to an auction in Newent, Gloucester.
It’s the last day for Thomas Plant and Mark Hales and it’s all down to the final auction.
David Barby and David Harper grapple with Euros as they travel from Athlone to Kells in Ireland.
Philip Serrell and Natasha Raskin shop in Hertfordshire, Oxfordshire and Buckinghamshire before heading to West London for a crucial auction.
Phil Serrell and Jonathan Pratt stop in the Lake District, and end up in Kirkby Lonsdale.
David Barby and David Harper have crossed the North Sea to Wales--and now the competition heats up as they travel from Prestatyn to Criccieth.
Natasha Raskin is playing catch up as she and fellow auctioneer Philip Serrell take a trip around Sussex and Kent before heading to their penulitimate auction in Rayleigh, Essex.
Phil Serrell and Jonathan Pratt continue their hunt, from Corbridge to Northallerton.
David Barby's after something quirky, while David Harper's going for the killer deal as they shop from Aberystwyth to the auction in Shrewsbury.
It's the last day for Natasha Raskin and Philip Serrell, and they cover Berkshire and Hampshire. But who will win at the final auction in Salisbury?
Phil Serrell leads as Jonathan Pratt struggles to find his form!
The conclusion of David Barby and David Harper's epic tour begins in Hereford--but who will be crowned king at the auction in Llanelli?
Phillip Serrell has a commanding lead but Jonathan Pratt is determined to catch him up.

Thomas Plant and Mark Stacey begin their adventure in Kent. Along the way, Thomas visits the life-saving underground world of Ramsgate, and Mark finds out about the science behind a lighthouse in Dover.
Charles Hanson and David Barby kick off their journey in Lichfield, Staffordshire, and head for an auction showdown in Coventry.
It’s Jonathan Pratt’s last day to claw back and catch the mighty Phil Serrell.
It's game on as Charles Hanson and David Barby travel from Malvern to a head-to-head auction in Pewsey Wiltshire.
Mark Stacey and Thomas Plant continue their trip through the Kent countryside. Mark is trailing behind, but can he catch Thomas when they head to an auction in Paddock Wood?
Anita Manning and James Lewis start their journey in Pateley Bridge, Yorkshire.
Its day three for Charles Hanson and David Barby as they battle it out from Ross on Wye, Herefordshire, to Frome in Somerset for the auction.
Antiques experts Thomas Plant and Mark Stacey are halfway through their road trip, and they shop in Essex and Suffolk before making their way to an auction in Cambridge.
Anita Manning and James Lewis continue to battle, starting in Horncastle, Lincolnshire.
It's all to play for as Charles Hanson and David Barby travel from Chester in Cheshire hunting antiques for the showdown in North Rode near Congleton.

Thomas Plant and Mark Stacey hunt for antiques across East Anglia. Along the way, Thomas hears the inspiring story of a pioneering nurse and Mark learns the incredible history of a Dunwich lost to the waves.
Anita Manning is close on the heels of James Lewis as they wind from Fakenham to Aylsham.
It's neck and neck between Charles Hanson and David Barby on the last leg of their journey from Stafford to Nottingham for the final showdown.

It's the last leg for antiques experts Mark Stacey and Thomas Plant as they travel through Norfolk. With less than £30 separating them, the pressure's on as they head to their final auction in Oakham, Rutland.
James Lewis leads but Anita Manning isn't out yet. It’s still all to play for in Bedford.
Newcomer Margie Cooper battles it out with veteran Mark Stacey, starting the week in Chilham, Kent, and ending at auction in Heathfield, East Sussex.
